title: Roadside Tea Stop
description: A continuous five-clip cinematic anime story about one young adult rider taking his classic motorcycle on a countryside outing and stopping for tea at a roadside stall.

workflow_intake_contract.checked_in_content: Complete example prompt book; replace it after intake for every new run.
questions: Idea/Prompt: What should the video be about?
Duration: How long should the finished video be? Maximum 5 minutes.

duration_planner.balanced_duration_formula: base=floor(total_seconds/clip_count); first remainder clips use base+1 seconds; all remaining clips use base seconds
duration_planner.adjustable_pacing: The agent may increase clip_count for story pacing while every clip remains 3-10 seconds and all clip durations sum exactly to the requested duration.

workflow_intake_contract.generation_rule: After all three answers are received, rewrite this prompt book from the user's idea, calculate scene count and per-scene durations from the requested duration, and propagate the normalized ratio and duration plan through global settings, every image composition, VideoExpress generation, canvas, timeline, save, and export. Define one immutable character bible per recurring character, including exact facial-hair state, and create verbatim positive and negative identity-lock sentences. Generate one master portrait per character, reuse its stable reference ID in every scene, and never chain scene outputs as references. Paste both identity-lock sentences verbatim into every character scene prompt and run the mandatory still plus opening/midpoint/closing video-frame identity gates. Define one world_lock paragraph and one lighting_lock sentence and paste both verbatim into every image prompt. Give every scene a start_state and end_state forming an unbroken handoff chain: each scene's start_state restates the previous scene's end_state, each still depicts exactly its start_state, and every video's final beat settles into its end_state. Obey the strict identity, physics, world-lock, and sequential-flow contracts in SYSTEM_PROMPT.md.

global_settings.visual_style: Cinematic 2D anime-style animated film with clean expressive linework, soft painterly backgrounds, natural character proportions, warm realistic lighting, detailed rural scenery, and smooth visual continuity.
global_settings.duration_plan_note: This checked-in example uses five equal 7-second story beats. New runs default to ceil(total/10) clips, but may use more shorter clips when pacing benefits.
global_settings.world_lock: World lock: one continuous rural world; a gently curving two-lane countryside road runs left to right through green rice fields with scattered palm trees and low hills beyond; the small roadside tea stall stands on the right shoulder of the road with a weathered timber frame, faded teal corrugated roof, clay-colored counter, steel kettle, glass tea cups, two wooden stools, a blank signboard, and one large banyan tree directly behind it; dry warm season, partly cloudy sky, calm air, warm amber-and-green palette.
global_settings.lighting_lock: Lighting lock: constant warm late-afternoon sunlight low at the left of frame, soft long shadows, no visible sun disc; identical warmth, sky, and tone in every scene.
global_settings.impossibility_guard: Physics guard: Actor 1 is always either fully seated on the saddle or standing with both boots on the ground, and the motorcycle's wheels always stay on the road or gravel surface.
continuity_rules: Use Actor 1's consistent-character portrait reference for every scene.
Use one stored master portrait media ID for Actor 1 in every scene; never regenerate the master reference and never use a previous scene output as the next scene's identity reference.
Actor 1's facial_hair_state is none_clean_shaven: his clean-shaven face never gains a moustache, mustache, beard, goatee, stubble, or changed sideburns in any image or any video frame.

Paste Actor 1's identity_lock_sentence and negative_identity_lock_sentence verbatim into every text_to_image_prompt; every image_to_video_prompt begins with the positive identity lock and ends with the negative identity lock plus the unchanged-in-every-frame clause.

Keep Actor 1's face, age, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, mustard-yellow windbreaker worn zipped halfway over the charcoal T-shirt, dark blue jeans, brown riding boots, and matte-black open-face helmet identical across all five clips.

Keep the same unbranded classic black bullet-style motorcycle with chrome fuel tank panels, round headlamp, tan leather saddle, twin rear shocks, and black exhaust in every scene; exactly one motorcycle, one helmet, one kettle, and one glass cup in Actor 1's hands at any time.

Paste the world_lock and lighting_lock sentences verbatim into every text_to_image_prompt, and repeat the same palette, weather, and lighting words inside every image_to_video_prompt; never paraphrase them and never let lighting jump between scenes.

Physical grounding: every still shows a stable fully supported pose; mounting, dismounting, and sitting down happen only inside video beats with the receiving support named; the physics guard sentence appears in both prompts of every riding or parking scene.

Every directional action names its direction relative to the frame and a world_lock landmark, and names where the object or vehicle ends up; the still pose, the timed beats, and the landing point must agree.

Hard handoff chain: each scene's start_state restates the previous scene's end_state; each still depicts exactly its start_state; every video's final beat settles into its end_state with nothing mid-air, mid-step, or mid-mount at the cut; location changes only through movement shown on screen.
Travel direction is left to right in every riding scene; the tea stall is always on the right shoulder with the banyan tree behind it; screen-side anchors never flip.
Keep faces clear and unobstructed during important expressions; use stable cinematic framing and simple readable actions.
Use clean unmarked frames, blank signboards, plain unbranded surfaces, and no readable writing, captions, watermarks, trademarks, or logos.
Synchronize motorcycle, road, wind, tea-stall, kettle, cup, and environmental sound effects with visible actions.
